local_articles.title: Fery seeks birthday date with destiny as Djokovic eyes more history
local_articles.snippet: LONDON, July 9 - Novak Djokovic's age-defying pursuit of tennis immortality continues on Friday with a Wimbledon semi-final against Jannik Sinner, although that blockbuster duel has been challenged unexpectedly for top billing. British wildcard Arthur Fery has embarked on one of the most astonishing runs in Wimbledon history and another victory against French Open champion Alexander Zverev would put him into Sunday's final on his 24th birthday. French-born Fery, who grew up a short walk away from Centre Court, is very much the outlier in a high-powered quartet. A fortnight ago, ranked 114th in the world and with only two previous Grand Slam match victories to his name, he could have walked down Wimbledon High Street in complete obscurity. local_articles.snippet: LONDON - Karolina Muchova and Linda Noskova will put their friendship on hold when they fight for the Wimbledon title on July 11 after the Czech pair took contrasting paths to their first All England Club final. Muchova saved a match point in a pulsating 6-2, 1-6, 7-6 (12/10) semi-final win against two-time Grand Slam champion Coco Gauff that lasted over two hours in sweltering 33 deg C heat on July 9. local_articles.title: Muchova's heroics sink Gauff to seal all-Czech Wimbledon final with Noskova
local_articles.snippet: For a place in the Wimbledon final, Karolina Muchova was ready to put her body on the line. A maiden Grand Slam title could heal all her past wounds when she takes on Czech compatriot Linda Noskova on Saturday. Even as Muchova's surgically patched-up body went hurtling towards the turf after conjuring a showstopping dive volley to catch Coco Gauff off guard in their semifinal, she never lost sight of the ball. So what if the shot had taken the racket out of her hands or that the fall could once again damage a body that had already been put through the wringer with an assortment of ankle, abdominal and wrist injuries? That single-minded focus allowed Muchova to end Gauff's incredible run of living dangerously at this year's Wimbledon as she saved a match point in the third set tiebreak to topple the American in a nerve-shredding 6-2 1-6 7-6 (12-10) thriller. questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Chinese authorities' figures in contemporaneous news coverage. Resolve to the Chinese province with the largest reported number of people evacuated in preparation for Typhoon Bavi as of July 11, 2026. Resolution Date : 2026-07-11 Accepted Answer Format : Answer with the province's name.
questions.current_reasoning: Mixed July 8 updates slightly narrow Zhejiang's margin over Fujian while compressing northern tails. Positively for Zhejiang: Zhejiang Maritime Safety Admin already activated Level-III response at 08:00 July 8, halted 52 ferry routes and 205 coastal construction projects, and evacuated >3,000 people from remote islands (ECNS/ChinaNews); Hangzhou Party Secretary Liu Fei placed the city in 'combat readiness' preparing for a 2019 Lekima-like direct Zhejiang strike with Siling Reservoir already releasing Meiyu floodwater; and Taiwan CWA/JMA/KMA still project an offshore 'Northwest Typhoon' track north of Taiwan while JTWC/HKO track even further NE near Yaeyama (NCDR/LTN). Counterbalancing toward Fujian: Bavi held 16.9N moving due west (134.1E -> 133.1E) on July 8, prompting CMA to nudge its official track slightly southward to northern Taiwan landfall/graze July 11 daytime followed by mainland landfall Saturday night July 11 between Fuqing (Fujian) and Wenling (Zhejiang) (Xinhua/MEM/FZNews), while State Flood Control HQ activated Level-IV response for both Zhejiang and Fujian and Fujian ordered all fishing boats and aquaculture raft personnel across Ningde, Fuzhou, Pingtan, Putian, and Quanzhou evacuated ashore by July 9-10. Because CMA's southward adjustment directly drives provincial preemptive evacuations on July 10-11, Fujian rises +0.04 (0.25 -> 0.29) and Zhejiang trims slightly (0.68 -> 0.66), remaining strongly favored given its massive right-front-quadrant exposure, Meiyu saturation, and historical evacuation scale. Slower forward speed (17-20 km/h, pushing mainland landfall to July 11 night-July 12 morning) and southward CMA shift compress Shanghai (0.045 -> 0.03) and Jiangsu (0.015 -> 0.01; Jiangsu's July 9-10 notice suspends in-person school activities, not mass evacuations), with Guangdong at 0.005 (0.005 residual).

local_articles.snippet: BEIJING – Typhoon Bavi churned south-east of Taiwan in the Pacific Ocean on July 9 , its winds easing overnight to just shy of 200kmh, as authorities urged residents to stock up on supplies and brace themselves for what could be the most powerful typhoon since 2024. questions.title: If Bavi makes landfall in mainland China during July 2026, which province will it strike first?
questions.background: Landfall occurs when a tropical cyclone's center crosses the coastline. This question concerns only mainland China.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official landfall reports from China’s National Meteorological Center, supplemented by contemporaneous reporting from major news organizations. Resolution Conditions : Resolve to the province containing the location of Bavi’s first mainland-China landfall during July 2026. Subsequent landfalls do not count. If no qualifying landfall occurs during that month, the question is void. Accepted Answer Format : The name of the province.
questions.current_reasoning: July 8 multi-agency synthesis (Taiwan NCDR/LTN, Xinhua/MEM, CMA, JMA, JTWC, HKO) shows a clear three-camp spread straddling the Zhejiang-Fujian border (~27.15N) with CMA explicitly nudging southward after Bavi held 16.9N moving due west (134.1E -> 133.1E) and slowed to 17-20 km/h. Camp 1 (CMA/NMC, southernmost): shifted south on July 8 morning to forecast a northern Taiwan landfall/graze July 11 daytime followed by mainland China landfall Saturday night July 11 along Fuqing (Fujian, ~25.7N) to Wenling (Zhejiang, ~28.4N), with National Marine Forecast Center targeting central Fujian to southern Zhejiang and Fuzhou Met explicitly not ruling out a Fuzhou strike. Camp 2 (Taiwan CWA, JMA, KMA, middle consensus): aligned on an offshore 'Northwest Typhoon' track west of Iriomote and north of Taiwan (no Taiwan landfall), pointing directly toward the Fujian-Zhejiang border (Cangnan/Wenzhou vs Fuding/Ningde). Camp 3 (JTWC, HKO, northernmost): track further NE through Yaeyama Islands well offshore of Taiwan, targeting Zhejiang (or Shanghai/offshore recurvature). Weighting all three camps conditional on mainland China landfall shifts probability modestly southward from Zhejiang (0.53 -> 0.50) to Fujian (0.395 -> 0.44), while tighter ~72-84h error cones compress Shanghai (0.04 -> 0.035) and Guangdong (0.015 -> 0.005), keeping Jiangsu at 0.015 (0.005 residual for Shandong/Liaoning).

questions.current_reasoning: June 29 Seattle Times coverage citing Bloomberg News reports that first-round bids to buy the Seattle Seahawks were due Monday, June 29 (earlier than previously rumored July 6), that no new potential buyers have emerged beyond the three previously identified groups (Aditya Mittal & Wyc Grousbeck, Todd Boehly, and Vinod Khosla), and that the bidder pool is 'fairly shallow' and 'shrinking' as the record $9B-$10B valuation tests billionaires' cash appetite. Confirming a shallow pool with no newly reported suitors on bid-deadline day concentrates probability mass onto the three active groups (Mittal/Grousbeck 0.30, Boehly 0.25, Khosla 0.23; combined 0.78, up from 0.66), while trimming unmentioned names Apostolopoulos (0.04), Bezos (0.03), and the unannounced mystery-bidder tail (from 23% to 15%).
